name: ims
description: Root manifest that exists so Heroku's nodejs buildpack builds the React app in frontend/ during deploy. The python buildpack then serves the result from frontend/dist via WHITENOISE_ROOT (see ims/settings.py). Without this, frontend/dist had to be committed by hand with `git add -f` — it is gitignored — and any forgotten rebuild shipped an index.html pointing at a JS bundle that was not in the slug.

scripts.build: npm ci --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.//: --include=dev is deliberate: vite is a devDependency of frontend/, and a build environment that sets NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=true would otherwise skip it and fail. node_modules is dropped afterwards so it doesn't ride along in the slug.
